items.exampleEn: Suburban trains are very crowded in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 早上的郊區火車非常擁擠。

items.exampleEn: The map shows the terrain of the island in detail.
items.exampleZh: 這張地圖詳細顯示了島上的地形。

items.exampleEn: Huge tracts of forest have been cleared for farming.
items.exampleZh: 大片的森林被砍伐，改作農地。

items.exampleEn: The orchard is full of cherry blossoms in spring.
items.exampleZh: 春天時，果園裡開滿了櫻花。

items.exampleEn: Italy is a long peninsula in southern Europe.
items.exampleZh: 義大利是位於南歐的一個狹長半島。

items.exampleEn: Trucks carry rocks from the quarry to the building site.
items.exampleZh: 卡車把石頭從採石場運到工地。

items.exampleEn: We camped in a wooded valley near the river.
items.exampleZh: 我們在河邊一座林木茂密的山谷露營。

items.sentenceEn: The hills behind our town are heavily wooded.
items.sentenceZh: 我們鎮後面的山丘樹木非常茂密。

items.audioEn: We stopped at an orchard and picked our own apples.
items.audioZh: 我們在一座果園停下來，自己摘蘋果。

items.sentenceEn: The rocky terrain made the bike ride slow and difficult.
items.sentenceZh: 多石的地形讓騎車變得又慢又辛苦。

items.sentenceEn: Workers used to cut stone from this old quarry.
items.sentenceZh: 工人以前從這座舊採石場開採石頭。

items.stemEn: The town sits on a narrow ____ with the sea on three sides.
items.stemZh: 這個小鎮坐落在一個三面環海的狹長半島上。

items.stemEn: They bought a large ____ of land to build a new school.
items.stemZh: 他們買下一大片土地，準備蓋一所新學校。

items.passageEn: Last year, the Lee family left their small city apartment and moved to a suburban town about an hour away. Their new house stands on a quiet tract of land next to a wooded hill. The terrain is steep, so the children ride their bikes carefully. Behind the hill, there is an old quarry that has been turned into a lake for swimming. On weekends, the family visits an apple orchard on the nearby peninsula, where the sea views are wonderful. The parents say the move has been advantageous for everyone, although the drive to work is longer.
items.passageZh: 去年，Lee 家離開城裡的小公寓，搬到大約一小時車程外的郊區小鎮。他們的新房子坐落在一片安靜的土地上，旁邊是一座林木茂密的山丘。這裡地勢陡峭，所以孩子們騎腳踏車都很小心。山丘後面有一座舊採石場，已經改建成可以游泳的湖。週末時，一家人會去附近半島上的蘋果園，那裡的海景非常美。父母說，這次搬家對每個人都有好處，只是開車上班的路程變長了。

questions.questionZh: Lee 家的新房子在哪裡？
options: 靠近市中心的熱鬧商店街上
一座林木茂密的山丘旁

questions.questionZh: 山丘後面的舊採石場現在怎麼樣了？
options: 被改建成一座大型停車場
仍然每天有工人在採石

items.promptZh: 他們住在一個風景很美的半島上。
referenceEn: They live on a peninsula with beautiful views.
Their home is on a very beautiful peninsula.
rubricZh: peninsula 表示「半島」（例如 live on a peninsula、a small peninsula 等）
「風景很美」可寫，例如 with beautiful views、very beautiful 等

items.instructionZh: 用 suburban 造一個句子，說說你喜歡或不喜歡住在郊區的理由。
referenceEn: I like suburban life because the streets are quiet and safe.
I don't enjoy living in a suburban area because I have to drive everywhere.
rubricZh: suburban 是形容詞，位置有彈性（例如 suburban life、a suburban area、is suburban 等）
句子要說出你自己的理由

執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
